items.title: Lettuce. Blueberries. Eggs. Jalapeños. Why are there so many food-safety scares this summer?
items.summary: From Cyclospora in lettuce to E. coli in blueberries, food-safety scares are making headlines. Here's what to know about the recalls and outbreaks.
items.titleZh: 生菜。蓝莓。鸡蛋。贾拉佩尼奥斯。为什么今年夏天有这么多食品安全恐慌？
items.summaryZh: 从生菜中的环孢菌到蓝莓中的大肠杆菌，食品安全恐慌成为头条新闻。以下是对召回和疫情的了解。

items.title: Pixel 11 Pro XL review: Snappier cameras can't hide an iterative upgrade
items.summary: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL brings snappier cameras and genuinely useful AI features like Rambler, but its iterative upgrades may not be enough to tempt recent Pixel owners.
items.titleZh: Pixel 11 Pro XL评测：Snappier相机无法隐藏迭代升级
items.summaryZh: 谷歌的Pixel 11 Pro XL带来了更快的摄像头和像Rambler这样真正有用的人工智能功能，但其迭代升级可能不足以吸引最近的Pixel用户。

items.title: ‘The U.S. is not the only game in town anymore’ — Treasury debt faces more competition from higher-yielding bonds overseas than in recent decades
items.summary: Yields on U.K. bonds have reached 5.81%, and German bonds are also paying 3.76%, versus 5.27% for a comparable U.S. bond. It's a big reason U.S. rates have been drifting higher.
items.titleZh: “美国不再是唯一的游戏了”——与近几十年相比，美国国债面临着来自海外高收益债券的更多竞争
items.summaryZh: 英国债券收益率已达到5.81%，德国债券收益率也为3.76%，而美国债券收益率为5.27%。这是美国利率持续走高的一个重要原因。

items.title: Anthropic could raise $100bn, ten times Europe’s largest listing in decades
items.summary: Anthropic could raise around $100bn in an October listing, with backers modelling a valuation of at least $2tn. The company says it has set no target.
items.titleZh: Anthropic可能筹集1000亿美元，是欧洲数十年来最大规模上市的十倍
items.summaryZh: Anthropic可能在10月份的上市中筹集约1000亿美元，支持者的估值至少为2万亿美元。该公司表示没有设定目标。

items.title: I dropped out of college and now earn $159,000 as a software engineer. Lifestyle creep left me $30,000 in debt.
items.summary: A Brooklyn-based software engineer, shares his journey from college dropout to a six-figure salary and managing NYC's high living costs.
items.titleZh: 我大学辍学了，现在作为一名软件工程师赚了15.9万美元。生活方式的转变让我负债3万美元。
items.summaryZh: 一位布鲁克林的软件工程师分享了他从大学辍学到六位数薪水和管理纽约高昂生活成本的经历。

items.title: Uber driver says these 3 behaviors will get passengers a 1-star rating
items.summary: Uber driver Levi Spires says the number one way to get a 1-star rating from him is making him wait without an explanation or apology.
items.titleZh: 优步司机表示，这3种行为将为乘客提供1星评级
items.summaryZh: 优步司机Levi Spires表示，获得一星级评价的首要方法是让他在没有解释或道歉的情况下等待。

items.title: Meta is the latest tech giant to land in her courtroom. Meet Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers
items.summary: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers has presided over a series of landmark tech trials and is now overseeing a case that could have a huge impact on Meta's future.
items.titleZh: Meta是最新一家进入法庭的科技巨头。法官Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers
items.summaryZh: 法官Yvonne Gonzalez-Rogers主持了一系列具有里程碑意义的技术审判，现在正在监督一个可能对Meta的未来产生巨大影响的案件。

items.title: AI’s Three-Body Problem: no single force can dictate the outcome
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are one body, China's open-weight models are another, and then there are the application companies built on top of both.
items.titleZh: 人工智能的三体问题：没有一种力量可以决定结果
items.summaryZh: OpenAI和Anthropic是一个整体，中国的开放权重模型是另一个，然后是建立在两者之上的应用公司。

items.title: This CEO was out to dinner when he caught his AI agent wasting $1,000 in tokens. He says ‘insecurity’ is a bigger problem
items.summary: "A thousand is not that much, I would say, but for one weekend, it's pretty annoying," Maxio CEO Branden Jenkins told Fortune.
items.titleZh: 这位首席执行官外出吃饭时，发现他的人工智能代理浪费了1000美元的代币。他说“不安全感”是一个更大的问题
items.summaryZh: Maxio首席执行官Branden Jenkins告诉《财富》杂志：“我想说，一千并不多，但一个周末，这很烦人。”。

items.summaryZh: 首先，Dave Cote改变了霍尼韦尔。退休后，他对一家名为Vertiv的鲜为人知的公司下了惊人的赌注。
